narrative.intro: Bollinger Shipyards Lockport L L C has $2.2B in contract obligations in FY2026 to date across 7 awards, with an average award size of $316M and year-over-year obligations up 1119.0%. Bollinger Shipyards recorded smaller totals in prior fiscal years: FY21 $259M, FY22 $168M, FY23 $195M, FY24 $54.5M, and FY25 $181M. Bollinger Shipyards received the bulk of FY2026 obligations from the Department of Homeland Security, which obligated $2.2B, while the Department of Defense obligated $3.6M. Bollinger Shipyards shows a concentrated buyer base in the current fiscal year, and the current-year totals are partial because they cover fiscal year to date. Bollinger Shipyards average award size and the significant year-over-year increase reflect how a small number of large awards can shift annual totals.
